# Osmar Alejandro Betancourt Avello

> End-to-end AI Platform Engineer & founder of DreamIT Software (Full Stack · Cloud · DevSecOps · MCPs / AI Agents). 5+ years shipping production platforms across the whole stack: self-hosted Kubernetes at millions of requests/day, multi-service backends (Django/Rust/Node), native iOS/Android, and AI-agent/LLM integrations. Based in Caracas, Venezuela.

## AI / ML & Agents

- Fine-tuning: LoRA, PEFT, Hugging Face (Certified: LLM, MCP, Agents courses); fine-tuned Mistral-7B

- Vision & speech: Google MediaPipe (FaceLandmarker), Apple Vision, Google STT/TTS, vision-language OCR
- Data science: ETL pipelines (Python/SQL/Pandas), Splink probabilistic record linkage, statsmodels, custom fuzzy/phonetic dedup (RapidFuzz, jellyfish, Spanish Metaphone)

## Selected projects (described by capability, strongest first)
- High-traffic real-time emergency-response platform: ~3M requests/day (measured in Cloudflare), zero downtime, on self-hosted k3s provisioned as code (OpenTofu). HPA (API 3→30 pods) + cluster-autoscaler, PgBouncer, Cloudflare+Valkey caching/rate-limit edge, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki, DevSecOps CI.
- Multi-domain work-management & analytics platform: 32-service Django backend; AWS via CloudFormation (EC2 ASG + ALB, RDS Postgres + read-replica, ElastiCache, S3, CloudFront); Celery workers.
- Native iOS app: on-device face-landmark computer vision (Apple Vision + AVFoundation), real-time SSE + voice assistant, Siri App Intent.
- Multi-tenant analytics SaaS in Rust (Axum/SeaORM/Tokio/sqlx), OpenAPI, with a daily prod→local data-sync using read-only schema isolation.
- Also: native Android (Kotlin/Compose); pgvector + multi-worker Node backend with self-hosted observability; custom MCP servers with hand-rolled OAuth 2.1 + PKCE; conversational-commerce platform (page loads 5–6s → ~60ms across 500+ products).
